sources.snippet: The default GGUF chat template is the unchanged original Mage-VL-Cowork multimodal template. sources.title: Mage — A Lightweight, Research-Friendly Multimodal Model Family
sources.snippet: Mage is a family of lightweight, research-friendly multimodal models built at a 4B-parameter scale, spanning visual understanding, generation, and computer use. Mage-VL and Mage-Flow share a codec-aligned efficiency philosophy—spend representation capacity where the signal is.
